body: Forward test of the sector cycle/lead indicator method (NOT a recommendation; not buy/sell). Probability 0.55 (naive base rate 0.45) that: Deepak Nitrite Q3 FY27 consolidated operating profit is ≥₹500 cr. Evidence: Q2 FY27 call (30-Oct-2026): record revenue ₹3,091 cr (+61%), EBITDA ₹643 cr (+187%), margin ~21%; Phenolics revenue ₹2,291 cr, EBIT ₹515 cr, 'principal driver… disruptions to international supply chains, higher landed cost of imports' (West Asia); H1 Phenolics EBIT ₹933 cr already above best-ever full year (FY22 ₹867 cr). Advanced Intermediates EBIT fell to ₹49 cr (6%); CFO guided Q3 AI EBIT% 'between Q1 and Q2, closer to Q1', Q4 better. New DCTL chlorination/photohalogenation assets commissioned end-Q2. Screener OP: Q3 FY26 211, Q4 FY26 376, Q1 FY27 540, Q2 FY27 627 (₹ cr). Reasoning: Lead indicator: phenol/acetone spreads are being held up by import disruption that was still in place into Q3 (Brent Q4-to-date ~$103 vs Q3 ~$91.5), while AI segment guidance points up and new assets add volume. A 20% fall from Q2 is needed to miss. We lean above the mean-reversion base. Resolution: YES if Deepak Nitrite's consolidated Operating Profit (screener.in quarterly table; equivalently EBITDA excluding other income) for the quarter ended 31-Dec-2026 is ≥₹500 cr. Source: Deepak Nitrite Q3 FY27 results (NSE) / screener.in consolidated quarterly table. Resolve by 2027-02-28; score with Brier vs base rate.

data.base_rate_reasoning: After a record spread-driven quarter, Indian commodity-chemical makers see a ≥20% sequential operating-profit fall roughly half the time or more; naive P(OP ≥ ₹500 cr) ~45%.

body: Promise-credibility forward test, Nov-2026 cohort (NOT a recommendation; not buy/sell). Neogen Chemicals (NEOGEN). Probability 0.55 (naive sector base rate 0.56) that: Neogen Chemicals (NEOGEN) FY27 standalone operating margin >= 16.2% (18% - 1.5 pp - 0.3 pp tolerance). Probabilities set only by the pre-registered rule (research_notes/Promise tracker pilot/forward_test_2026-11/prereg.md s4): p0 = 0.562 (pooled all cohort + T&D companies, group 'margin' (sector pool n=7 < 8), n=32); SAC -0.065 x w 0.130 (N=3) -> P_cred = 0.55. Evidence: call of 2026-07-27: "For EBITDA margin in the current year, our base is 18% plus-minus 1%, 1.5%" (Q1FY27). Resolution: YES if FY27 standalone operating profit / revenue >= 16.2%. Source: Q4FY27 results, press release / investor presentation and Q4FY27 earnings call transcript (NSE). Resolve by 2027-06-15; score Brier of P_cred vs P_base (prereg s5).
